mainEntity.name: Do you post on the client's behalf?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you give us access or use a scheduling tool with approval steps. You choose the approval level.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle comments and messages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reply drafts or live replies can be included, within rules you set. Sensitive cases come to you.
Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X are the usual. We agree the set per client.

mainEntity.name: Do you produce original photos and video?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can edit supplied footage and create designs. Shoots are a separate scope.

mainEntity.name: Will my client know MMC is involved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if you choose to tell them. We sign an NDA, work under your brand, send deliverables in your format and do not contact your clients unless you ask us to.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: White-label social media management means MMC runs your client's social channels while you stay the agency they hire. We plan the calendar, design the posts, schedule and publish, handle community replies where agreed, and send a monthly report you can put your name on.

stages.breaks: Brand rules live in someone's head.
stages.why: Posts drift from the client's look as soon as a new person touches the account.
stages.does: We capture colours, tone and no-go topics in a one-page brand sheet and design every post from it.

stages.breaks: The month is planned the week before.
stages.why: Last-minute posts are thin, and the client sees gaps.
stages.does: We plan the month by theme and channel and share the calendar, so you can see holes early.

stages.breaks: Approvals arrive after the post is due.
stages.why: A late sign-off forces a choice between a missed date and an unchecked post.
stages.does: Approval steps and cut-off times are agreed with you, and nothing is published without a recorded yes.

stages.why: A client's followers expect a reply, and silence looks like neglect.
stages.does: We draft replies, or answer within rules you set, and flag anything sensitive to you.

stages.breaks: The report is a screenshot of likes.
stages.why: Likes do not tell your client what to do next.
stages.does: Your monthly report covers reach, engagement and what we change next month, in your format.
